steps.createSession: Create a session in the workspace

exitMessage: Skip the guide now? You can restart it later from **Settings → General** with **Restart basic guide**.
endCopy: Find more tips in the docs or community. Vibing~~~

copy.select-project-create: In VibeX, create or choose a **project** to continue. A **project** is a folder that isolates Agent sessions and work state.
copy.select-project-global: **Global** is your user folder — click **Global** to continue.
copy.need-agent: Setup moved a bit fast — no Agent is ready yet. Enable and sign in to an Agent in **Settings → Agent**.
copy.settings-agent-icon: Select an Agent to open its settings.
copy.settings-agent-enable: Turn on Enable so VibeX can install its connector.
copy.settings-agent-acp: Downloading, installing, and checking the connector. Hang on.
copy.settings-agent-auth: Sign in with a subscription or add an API key so the Agent can run.
copy.return-main: An Agent is ready. Return to the main window to create a session.
copy.click-new-session: First, click this button to create a session.
copy.configure-session-agent: First **choose** the Agent for this session.
copy.submit-session: Click the button to create the session.
copy.send-hello: Edit “你好” in the input, then send. When the Agent starts replying, this step is done.
copy.rail-session-list: This is the session list for the current workspace.
copy.rail-file-tree: This is the file tree for browsing and opening project files.
copy.rail-git: This is the Git panel for changes, commits, and branches.
copy.click-kanban: Open Kanban to see the session hub and usage stats.
copy.kanban-create-session: Click + on the session list to create another session.
copy.kanban-click-sessions: If the monitor is empty, click both sessions in the list.
copy.kanban-execution: This is the execution area, where the active conversation lives.
copy.kanban-monitor: This is the monitor area, for watching several sessions at once.
copy.kanban-move-to-execution: Click Move to execution to bring a monitored session into the execution area. Monitor is for parallel watch; execution is for the deep conversation.
copy.usage-next-page: Use the right arrow to open usage stats.
copy.usage-overview-cards: The top cards summarize usage and cost.
